name: Security Issuer 4
definition: Specifies the identification of the issuer of a security.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Legal entity identification of the issuer of the security.

JurisdictionCountry.name: Jurisdiction Country
JurisdictionCountry.definition: Jurisdiction of the issuer of the security used as collateral. In case of securities issued by a foreign subsidiary, the jurisdiction of the ultimate parent company shall be reported or, if not known, jurisdiction of the subsidiary.
